text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature spent the day with Mejiro 
McQueen and Mejiro Ryan to learn the 
secret of their strength.

After spending the entire day accompanying 
the two in training, she realized how 
deeply they respected and pushed one 
another to greater heights.

Nice Nature realized the importance of 
paying attention to her surroundings and 
facing herself.

Looking ahead to the Takarazuka Kinen... 
her desire to "win" against those two grew 
even stronger.
